# Model evaluation report (generated by train.py)

- Rows: 1364; classes: 14; near-duplicate groups: 424
- scikit-learn 1.9.1; seed 42; model version 1.0
- Short-fragment training augmentation: OFF (shipped configuration)
- Input = raw `symptom_description` text only. Leaky columns are not used.
- NOT clinically validated. Scores come from a small, templated, probably synthetic dataset.
- 'full' = original long descriptions; 'short' = 1-3 clause fragments cut from descriptions (a stand-in for brief user input, NOT real user text).

## Split

- Development rows: 1073; held-out test rows: 291 (no shared near-duplicate group)
- Classes missing from test set: none

## Model comparison (grouped stratified 5-fold CV on development set, macro-F1)

| model              |   f1_full |   f1_short |   f1_short_std |   mean(full, short) |
|:-------------------|----------:|-----------:|---------------:|--------------------:|
| LinearSVC C=1      |    0.9662 |     0.7813 |         0.0073 |              0.8737 |
| LinearSVC C=0.3    |    0.9641 |     0.7765 |         0.008  |              0.8703 |
| LogReg C=100       |    0.9642 |     0.7606 |         0.0148 |              0.8624 |
| LogReg C=10        |    0.9615 |     0.7537 |         0.0142 |              0.8576 |
| LogReg C=1         |    0.9555 |     0.7365 |         0.0114 |              0.846  |
| ComplementNB a=0.1 |    0.9251 |     0.7211 |         0.0526 |              0.8231 |
| ComplementNB a=0.5 |    0.9189 |     0.7075 |         0.0454 |              0.8132 |

Selected: **LinearSVC C=1** (highest mean of full and short macro-F1). Candidates within one standard deviation are statistically indistinguishable.

## Calibration (out-of-fold, development set)

- full: accuracy 0.966; macro-F1 0.968; ECE 0.130; Brier 0.085
- short: accuracy 0.772; macro-F1 0.776; ECE 0.129; Brier 0.345

## Abstention threshold

- Chosen on short-fragment out-of-fold predictions: smallest threshold with selective accuracy >= 90% -> **0.50**
  - threshold 0.3: coverage 92%, accuracy when shown 0.814
  - threshold 0.4: coverage 83%, accuracy when shown 0.857
  - threshold 0.5: coverage 72%, accuracy when shown 0.904
  - threshold 0.6: coverage 59%, accuracy when shown 0.939
  - threshold 0.7: coverage 46%, accuracy when shown 0.963

## Held-out test set (group-aware split, evaluated once)

- **full** (n=291): accuracy **0.976**, macro-F1 **0.967**, top-3 1.000; at threshold 0.50: coverage 98.6%, accuracy when shown 0.986; ECE 0.108
